_note: PLACEHOLDER. The brief gives each party member exactly one Skill but no resource to spend on it, so a round-counted COOLDOWN is the stopgap limiter — without one, Skill strictly dominates Attack and the action bar has no decision in it. Counted in rounds, never seconds. 'owner' ties a skill to a party member; when the party expands past two, this moves onto the character instead. See questions-for-design Q11.
